findings.message: 9 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "168 MOVING & AUTO · 跨越距離，連結生活" above "下一站新生活， 我們陪你一路到家。"; "ONE TEAM. EVERY MOVE." above "不只運送， 是替你安排好每一步。"; "COAST TO COAST" above "不論下一站有多遠， 先把路線安排好。"; "A CLEAR WAY FORWARD" above "把複雜留給我們， 把期待留給新生活。"; "閱讀指南" above "04"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 14 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "168 MOVING & AUTO · 跨越距離，連結生活", "01 / 168 MOVING & AUTO", "YOUR NEXT CHAPTER, DELIVERED.", "CALIFORNIA → YOUR NEXT CHAPTER").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.hero-shade → linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(20, 46, 55) 2%, rgba(20, 46, 55, 0.77) 53%, rgba(20, 46, 55, 0.125))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.quick-quote → rgba(17, 46, 55, 0.07) 0px 14px 40px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 23 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.header 1440px | div.trust-strip 1440px | a.service-card 299px | a.service-card 299px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.9:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 98 characters per line.

findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Only 0 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.
